C0593.title: Nanjing Hotel Price Fraud Case
C0593.summary: In April 2024, the Qinhuai District Market Supervision Administration of Nanjing conducted routine inspections of the hotel industry and identified price fraud at a hotel, which was subsequently penalized according to law. This case was jointly released as one of seven typical cases of pricing violations.

references.title: Joint release! Seven typical cases of price violations
